scope: scene-only CloudSEN12+ clear-background augmentation under the exact MARS-S2L v3 benchmark contract
scientific_hypothesis: A low-capacity scene head trained with globally diverse, source-disjoint CloudSEN12+ clear scenes will suppress background artifacts at unseen emitter sites while preserving plume recall better than positive-only augmentation.

cloudsen12_clear.label_contract: Every row is explicitly isplume=false; the MARS-S2L paper uses this cohort as a global clear-scene false-positive benchmark.

methaneset_audit.decision: Do not treat as new labels: every unique target product is already present in MARS-S2L.

partitions.cloudsen12_training: published split_name=train only; 9,805 rows; fitting only
partitions.cloudsen12_development: published split_name=validation only; 256 rows; negative-domain gate only
partitions.cloudsen12_sealed_external: published split_name=test only; 374 rows; inaccessible until every original-development gate passes
partitions.mars_selection: cross-fitted folds 2, 3, and 4; each held fold is excluded from fitting
partitions.mars_confirmation: fixed-family cross-fitted folds 0 and 1; each held fold is excluded from fitting
partitions.final_refit: all five authorized MARS development folds plus CloudSEN12 training, only after all gates pass

feature_contract.inference_availability: All allowed fields are deterministic summaries of the released 16-channel operational input or its clear/valid mask.

base_architecture.scene_score: frozen v3 stronger OOF ExtraTrees head

invariants: CloudSEN12 test rows are never loaded during fitting, model selection, threshold selection, or development confirmation.
No MARS paper-test cache, label, metric, or imagery is loaded before a candidate passes every development gate.
No location, country, offshore, sector, plume geometry, flux, or split field is an input feature.
The exact MARS v3 comparator and promoted dense-mask branch remain unchanged.
Bulk source tables, rasters, features, and model artifacts remain ignored by Git; only compact protocols, receipts, and reports are committed.
